createPrediction.title: Create prediction
createPrediction.prefillBanner: Started from Upcoming events — the title and date are filled in, you just write the prediction to seal.
createPrediction.scopeGroupBody: This prediction is only visible to {{group}} members, not the public feed. Time capsules can currently only be created from your personal feed.
createPrediction.scopePublicBody: A verified outcome is added to your permanent record in the {{category}} category. Time capsules stay private to you and don't affect stats.
createPrediction.titlePlaceholder: My prediction for the upcoming derby
createPrediction.titleHint: This title is visible before the sealed content.
createPrediction.mediaPickCta: Add image (8 MB) or video (25 MB)
createPrediction.sealedSubtitle: Only visible the moment it opens
createPrediction.sealedHint: Once sealed, no one — including you — can see or change it until it opens.
createPrediction.sensitiveToggleBody: Shown with a warning label based on each viewer's display preference.
createPrediction.unlockSubtitle: Pick a moment for it to open for everyone — or leave it undated and open it whenever you decide.
createPrediction.unlockPastError: That moment has already passed — pick a future date/time.
createPrediction.unlockManualBody: This record never opens on its own. Go to the record page and open it whenever you want — five minutes from now or a year from now. But careful: once you open it, you can't seal it again.
createPrediction.verifyBody: You're the first to mark the outcome when it opens, but you don't have the final say — other users can vote "right/wrong" too, and the outcome can flip if the community disagrees with you.
createPrediction.submitHint: Once sealed, the record can't be changed.
createPrediction.videoTooLarge: Video can be at most 25 MB.
createPrediction.imageTooLarge: Image can be at most 8 MB.
createPrediction.videoUploadFailed: Video upload failed, the prediction will be saved without media.
createPrediction.imageUploadFailed: Image upload failed, the prediction will be saved without media.
createPrediction.genericError: Couldn't save the prediction, try again.
createPrediction.checkTooShort: Write a bit more detail — this looks too short.
createPrediction.checkNotSentence: This doesn't look like a prediction — write it as a normal sentence.
createPrediction.checkIsQuestion: This reads like a question. A prediction has to be a claim, not a question.
createPrediction.checkNoFutureClaim: This doesn't read like a future claim — write a clear call like "...will win" or "...will happen".

time.sealedUntilAuthorOpens: Sealed until the author opens it

settings.showTimeForYou: Show time the way you like it
settings.timeExplainer: Message timestamps follow this preference. Dates always spell out the month (e.g. August 29, 2026), so there's no separate date-order setting to make. Your time zone always follows your device automatically.
settings.eventTimezoneTitle: Event dates show in your local time
settings.eventTimezoneBody: Seal openings and prediction dates automatically follow your device's time zone — no need to pick a region.
settings.languageHint: Change the app's language. This preference is saved to your account and applies on all your devices.

activeSessions.title: Active sessions
activeSessions.heading: Devices you're signed in on
activeSessions.body: If you think an unfamiliar device signed in, you can sign out of every other device.
activeSessions.currentSession: The session you're using right now
activeSessions.noDeviceListBody: You can't see or close individual devices one by one yet — but the button below closes every session but this one at once.
activeSessions.unknownLoginTitle: See a login you don't recognize?
activeSessions.unknownLoginBody: Signing out of other devices and then changing your password secures your account.
activeSessions.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other devices
activeSessions.signOutSuccess: Every session but this device was signed out.

mentions.title: Tagging and Mentions
mentions.heading: Where should your name show up?
mentions.body: Choose who can mention you by writing @username in comments.
mentions.noOneDesc: Your name can't be @mentioned in comments
mentions.notifBody: Notify you in Activity when your name shows up with @ in a comment.
mentions.footerNote: Only @mentions in comments are supported right now. Mentions in prediction text or group content, reviewing past tags, and tag approval don't exist yet.

sensitiveContent.title: Sensitive content
sensitiveContent.heading: Tune your feed to you
sensitiveContent.body: Choose how records authors marked sensitive show up in your feed and in Discover.
sensitiveContent.lessDesc: Hide records marked sensitive from your feed and Discover.
sensitiveContent.standardDesc: Sensitive records show up with a warning label.
sensitiveContent.moreDesc: No extra filtering, sensitive records included.
sensitiveContent.footerNote: Sensitive marking is currently self-reported by the prediction's author — automatic image blurring and content moderation don't exist yet.

messageRequests.title: Message Requests
messageRequests.heading: Who can message you
messageRequests.body: Anyone outside this preference won't be able to send you a message.
messageRequests.everyoneDesc: People you don't follow can message you too
messageRequests.onlyFollowingDesc: Only people you follow can write to you
messageRequests.footerNote: Extra controls like spam filtering, a separate requests folder, and auto-delete don't exist yet — this preference currently only controls who can message you.

predictionVisibility.title: Privacy
predictionVisibility.heading: Prediction visibility
predictionVisibility.body: Choose who can see your public predictions. Predictions you post into a group are always limited to that group's members.
predictionVisibility.publicDesc: Anyone on GTF can see it on your profile.
predictionVisibility.followersOnlyDesc: Followers you've approved see your predictions (private account).
predictionVisibility.capsuleNoteTitle: Don't want to share one prediction with anyone
predictionVisibility.capsuleNoteBody: Pick "Time capsule" mode when creating a new prediction — it stays entirely personal, independent of your account visibility.
predictionVisibility.sealedNoteBody: Whatever your visibility choice, a sealed prediction's content can't be read by anyone until it opens.
predictionVisibility.footerNote: This preference shares the same switch as "Privacy → Private account" — changing either one updates the other too.
